messages.subject: For Larry Fink | Infrastructure investment, government partnerships and emerging-market strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Rodda,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Laurence D. Fink, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

BlackRock's expanding role across infrastructure, energy transition and long-horizon investment requires strong understanding of governments, regulated sectors and operating realities across markets. That intersection aligns closely with my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, infrastructure stakeholder strategy and emerging-market operating experience might support BlackRock's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to BlackRock.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
